title: Clamp Motor Power
instructions:
Complete the `clampPower` function. It takes a `power` value of type `Double` and returns a `Double`.

The function should:
- Return `1.0` if `power` is greater than `1.0`
- Return `-1.0` if `power` is less than `-1.0`
- Return `power` unchanged otherwise

This is how FRC robots keep motor values in a safe range!
hint: Use if/else if/else to check the three cases. Return the clamped value in each branch.
